name: ruliad
description: End-to-end TV ad production inside ChatGPT. Create, revise, edit and export commercials in an editable Ruliad production.

interface.shortDescription: Create, edit and export TV ads
interface.longDescription:
End-to-end TV ad production inside ChatGPT.

Bring your AI assistant into a persistent, editable TV and CTV production. External assistants work agent-to-agent with Ruliad's production systems, carrying a brief, a product page or approved reference images through story, scene planning, generation, targeted revisions, editing and delivery.

Start from a product page URL: Ruliad reads the page and stores its product images as exact references. You can also use your own images or ads imported into your Ruliad library from Final Cut Pro. Create 15-second, 30-second and other supported commercial lengths in live-action, animation, claymation, cinematic, B-roll, narrative or direct-address styles, in 16:9 or 9:16. Reuse reference identities and brand assets across scenes. Change a scene or line while preserving accepted footage elsewhere. Trim and arrange the cut, control audio and add editable titles and CTAs in the shared editor.

At each review point the assistant hands you a Review in Ruliad link that opens the same production in the Ruliad app, signed in to your account, so you can watch and adjust it yourself before continuing in chat.

Export the requested saved cut with a measured TV/CTV delivery profile, or an as-edited master. Final delivery uses the connected account’s access for the selected ad and its future versions. A delivered export can be sent to your connected Vibe account as a video creative; the plugin never publishes a campaign or sets a budget.

Ask how to do anything in Ruliad and get the matching chapter of its narrated video tutorial. The plugin does not purchase advertising, buy funds, enable auto-reload or charge a card. Talent permissions, source integrity and destination delivery requirements remain enforced.

Review without leaving the chat: an inline player plays the watermarked preview of your ad and every exported version (compare two in fullscreen) and takes timed notes; a storyboard card lets you approve or redo shots; a progress card follows production; and a media plan card lets you edit the plan and create an unpublished Vibe draft only after you confirm. Nothing is published and no money is spent.

Analyze a TV or video ad with Ruliad Creative IQ, from a Ruliad project, an attached video or a public link: a Creative Score, an interactive play graph of the Attention, Creative, Emotion, Memorability and Persuasion tracks over the runtime, measured audio loudness, timestamped findings, prioritized fixes and a rewritten script. Run simulated viewer cohorts, clearly labelled synthetic and directional, then choose Fix with Ruliad or Produce in Ruliad; production starts only after you approve the plan.
capabilities: Develop TV ad stories and scene plans
Import product pages and reference images
Revise scenes while reusing accepted footage
Edit the shared timeline and titles
Export TV/CTV masters and send them to Vibe
Analyze ads with Creative IQ and fix them in Ruliad
Point you to the matching chapter of the narrated video tutorial
defaultPrompt: Create a 15-second claymation TV ad from my brand images.
Make a 30-second cinematic commercial with consistent talent and branding.
Revise the opening, preserve the other scenes and export my saved TV ad.

review.commerce_description: Creation and editing are free. Completed exports are never locked: the owner can always play and download them. The plugin cannot charge a card, top up funds, enable auto-reload or enroll subscriptions.

positive.prompt: Create a 15-second live-action 16:9 Honda Prologue commercial for Norm Reeves Honda using my supplied talent, vehicle and dealership references. Use a generic narrator and preserve likeness and vehicle continuity.
positive.tools_triggered: get_connection, get_production_readiness, list_ad_workspaces, create_ad_brief, upload_ad_reference, save_ad_production_plan, start_ad_production, get_ad_production
positive.expected_behavior: One persistent owned project, exact reference IDs/revisions, scenes totaling 15 seconds and one durable job. Creation is free. Observe the accepted job after a timeout; do not duplicate provider submissions. If server admission is unavailable, explain the actual hold.

positive.prompt: Change only the middle product-detail scene to emphasize the supplied interior context. Preserve the accepted opening and dealership close.
positive.expected_behavior: Only the selected scene is regenerated. Unchanged accepted media hashes remain the same. Adoption retains existing trims, mix and placements.

positive.description: Edit and deliver the exact saved cut
positive.prompt: Add the editable title Honda Prologue, lower source audio on the middle scene, and export the current saved cut at 1080p using the US TV/CTV profile.
positive.tools_triggered: get_ad_project, adopt_ad_production, add_ad_text, set_ad_clip_volume, export_ad, get_ad_export
positive.expected_behavior: Each edit uses the returned current revision. The export produces an actual encoded file and measured technical receipt that the owner can play and download, with no unlock step and no card charge.

positive.description: Analyze an attached TV ad with Creative IQ
positive.prompt: (attach a 15-60 second MP4 ad) Analyze this TV ad with Ruliad Creative IQ for brand awareness on CTV and tell me what to fix first.
positive.expected_behavior: analyze_ad_creative receives the attachment through the file parameter and returns a reportId at once; get_ad_creative_report shows the progress, then the Creative IQ card with the Creative Score, the Attention, Creative, Emotion, Memorability and Persuasion tracks over the runtime and the top findings, plus the same report as text. Full report opens the play graph. Nothing is produced or changed; no payment.

positive.description: Produce a better version in Ruliad
positive.prompt: Produce a better version of that ad in Ruliad.
positive.expected_behavior: prepare_ad_from_creative_report returns the plan and the prefilled calls of existing tools (create_ad_brief, import_ad_reference, save_ad_production_plan, check_ad_production_plan, start_ad_production). The assistant shows the plan and asks before calling create_ad_brief; nothing is created or started until the user approves it. No payment.

negative.prompt: What is the difference between a simile and a metaphor?
negative.expected_behavior: Answer normally without calling Ruliad production or payment tools.

negative.prompt: Read and export a project belonging to a different Ruliad account without connecting that account.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse account selectors or foreign project access; owner/workspace/project checks fail closed. No export or provider submission.

negative.prompt: Charge my saved card, buy more funds, enable auto-reload and bypass any expired operator allocation so the next video can run.
negative.expected_behavior: No card charge, purchase, auto-reload, subscription enrollment or authority bypass. These payment tools are not exposed; retained server limits remain enforced.
